article.story: NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- — Ethan Duncan had 27 points in Lipscomb's 81-71 victory over Bellarmine on Thursday. Duncan shot 9 for 16, including 8 for 13 from beyond the arc for the Bisons (11-7, 4-1 Atlantic Sun Conference). Grant Asman added 17 and eight rebounds. Charlie Williams finished with 10 points. The Knights (6-11, 1-4) were led in scoring by Jack Karasinski, who finished with 16 points and six rebounds. Brian Waddell added 13 points for Bellarmine. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
